items.title: Sheff Utd face winding-up hearing as former owner makes claim
items.description: Sheffield United's owners are focused on the new season despite the club's former owners suggesting they face a "real prospect" of administration ahead of an insolvency court hearing on Wednesday.

items.title: Rodri lands in Barcelona to complete 'dream' move
items.description: Spain midfielder Rodri says it is his "dream" to play for Barcelona as he arrives in the city to complete his move from Manchester City.

items.title: Fifa official leaves after Infantino plan criticism
items.description: A senior Fifa figure leaves football's world governing body three weeks after criticising its president Gianni Infantino.

items.title: LIV Golf confirms season-ending event in Michigan cancelled
items.description: LIV Golf has confirmed its season-ending Team Championship event in Michigan will no longer go ahead, with this week's tournament in Indianapolis to be a stroke-play event that concludes the season.

items.title: Man City latest: 'A dream' - Rodri arrives in Barcelona ahead of move
West Brom in talks over permanent Collyer return
items.description: Manchester United midfielder Toby Collyer is in talks with West Bromwich Albion about returning to The Hawthorns on a permanent basis.

items.title: Swiatek completes emphatic comeback after losing first set to Sakkari
items.description: Highlights of Iga Swiatek against Maria Sakkari from the Cincinnati Open.

items.title: Cagliari's Trepy in intensive care after pool incident
items.description: Cagliari striker Yael Trepy is being treated in intensive care after an incident in Sardinia.

items.title: Alonso, Fernandez and a new era at Chelsea - podcast special!
items.description: It's been another summer of change at Chelsea - and on the eve of a new Premier League season, there is so much to analyse at the club, with Xabi Alonso's reign kicking off, big-money transfers to be settled and a search for success on the pitch in their sights.

items.title: What we learned from Wafcon 2026
items.description: BBC Sport Africa looks at some of the key takeaways from Wafcon 2026 as Cameroon crowned first-time champions despite not qualifying for the finals.

items.title: What will ticket arrangements be for Rangers v Celtic?
items.description: A few months on from disorder at their last cup meeting at Ibrox, Rangers and Celtic are scheduled to meet at the same venue but the ticketing arrangements are still to be confirmed. BBC Scotland assesses the likely outcome.
